<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
  <g:ui_form>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="showConfirmationDialog()">更新字段</button>
    
    <script>
      function showConfirmationDialog() {
        var dialog = new GlideDialogWindow('confirm_dialog');
        dialog.setTitle('确认更新');
        dialog.setPreference('table', 'your_table');
        dialog.setPreference('sys_id', g_form.getUniqueValue());
        dialog.setPreference('fieldValue', document.getElementById('field_input').value);
        dialog.render();
      }
      
      function processConfirmation(result, table, sys_id, fieldValue) {
        if (result == 'ok') {
          // 使用GlideAjax更新字段
          var ga = new GlideAjax('FieldUpdater');
          ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'updateField');
          ga.addParam('sysparm_table', table);
          ga.addParam('sysparm_sys_id', sys_id);
          ga.addParam('sysparm_field_value', fieldValue);
          ga.getXML(function(response) {
            var answer = response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer");
            if (answer === 'success') {
              alert('字段更新成功!');
              location.reload(); // 刷新页面
            } else {
              alert('更新失败');
            }
          });
        }
      }
    </script>
    
    <input type="text" id="field_input" class="form-control" />
  </g:ui_form>
</j:jelly>
sys_ui_page.name: Confirmation Dialog Example
